title: Episode 16
overview: The SSC's new director has his own ideas about how to operate the organisation. Eddy's research turns up a lead: former scientist William Herst

title: Episode 17
overview: Connor and Creighton break into Herst's house to get ot Tina. William fails to hold them off, but James and Wyatt show up to confront the intruders

title: Episode 18
overview: Harry leads a team into assaulting the supposedly secure SSC safe house where James and Tina are holed up. Somehow, SSC must have been compromised.

title: Episode 19
overview: While on the run from the SSC, James and Tina are deliberately hit by a truck. Looking for answers, James makes contact with Anna Winehouse.

title: Episode 20
overview: With Eddy's help, James tries to infiltrate the site where Tina is being held. Connor tells Tina about her family's involvement with the masks.

title: Episode 21
overview: James hands Connor over to Wyatt. In custody, Connor maintains his silence until Anna asks to question him herself.

title: Episode 22
overview: Anna tells Tina about the research that proceeded her birth. William Herst regains consciousness. Coates meets with a mysterious individual.

title: Episode 23
overview: Waiting for her father, Tina looks at Anna's old pictures of her parents. Wyatt and Eddy work together to find Gary Evans and stumble into an ambush.

title: Episode 24
overview: Coates puts out a warrant on Evans. James, Anna, Tina and Herst try to escape the hospital via helicopter, but Connor is already inside.
